class.name: TrainSoundListener3D
class.brief_description: Where the vehicles are heard from.
class.description: The player's listener: it follows the current camera every frame and knows the [Cabin3D] that camera is in. Whatever plays the vehicles' sounds finds it as it enters the tree and follows [signal context_changed].

method.name: get_listener_cabin
method.description: The cab the camera is in, [code]null[/code] outside every cab.

method.name: get_listener_context
method.description: The column of a soundproofing profile the listener hears from: [method Cabin3D.get_sound_listener_context] in a cab, [constant EXTERIOR_CONTEXT] outside.

method.name: get_listener_vehicle
method.description: The [VehicleServer] vehicle whose cab the listener is in, an empty [RID] outside.

method.name: is_inside_vehicle
method.description: Whether the listener is in a cab of [param vehicle].

signal.name: context_changed
signal.description: The listener's cab, vehicle or context changed.

constants.constant: The context outside every cab - the last column of a soundproofing profile.
